scope: Standing timber ranges at the historic court house, including the original hip-roofed office, raised gabled courtroom, the linked verandas, southern wing and rear additions.

originalReview.notes: The exact 1907 Crown architectural drawing identifies the old hip-roofed range, veranda, 25 ft courtroom width, floor height, planted street gables and covered approach. The archival sheet controls the 1897–1907 portions, while the standing outline and heritage listing control later additions.

quallaSearch.notes: Qualla’s plan was checked first. Its published JPEG exactly matches the Queensland State Archives plan with a reviewed Crown public-domain release. Modern attribution-only images are excluded.
